mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period indicates a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of overall economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the HOUST increases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month signals an improving labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over a 3-month period indicates a strengthening supply side of the economy, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the INDPRO increases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a 3-month period, it signals a strengthening consumer demand, which is a positive indicator for corporate revenues and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth over 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year growth rate of GDP (GDPC1) exceeds the year-over-year growth rate of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL), it indicates real economic growth outpacing inflation, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth > CPIAUCSL YoY growth
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.
